data.name: Harshith
data.gender_notes: Harshith is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Harshith is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Harshas' which means happiness, joy and pleasure. It is a name for a boy that is believed to bring joy and happiness in one's life. The name Harshith carries the meaning “Happy, Joyful” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Harshith usually hope their child will grow to embody happy, joyful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Harshith belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Happy, Joyful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Harshith total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
